verdict.rationale: Capacities' in-app AI chat answers from your notes, can plan multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve (docs-42, docs-23). Chat Connectors and the official MCP server also let you drive your space in natural language from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Le Chat (docs-3, probe-3). missing for 10: detailed documentation of which actions natural-language commands can perform (beyond create/update proposals), independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic operation.
